move: frosted cards rise blurred, page sideways three times, fling home, fade
how: Portrait iOS feed: a blurred aurora wall drifts xPercent -3 to 3 and rotates 2 degrees over the whole loop, four 760px cards with blurred colour-blob art and backdrop-filter glass panels rise from y 260 / blur(30px) / scale 0.94 with a 0.09s stagger (expo.out, 0.9s), plus header and tab bar. At 0.21D, 0.41D and 0.61D the track slides -796px (expo.out, 0.85s); the leaving card blurs to 14px and scales 0.96, the arriving one sharpens, and the pager pill widens 14 to 44px. At 0.81D the track flings back to 0 (expo.inOut) with the same blur swap, and the last 0.3s fades header, cards and tab to opacity 0 so the entrance can replay.
adapt: Replace the four card titles, tags, blurbs, bylines and blob colours, the header date and tab labels; keep STEP = card width + gap, the three 1.6s page beats and the 0.85s expo.out slide.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the wall, header, .track cards, dots and tab; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with beats at 0.21D/0.41D/0.61D/0.81D and the fade at 0.96D. Scope '.wall', '.track', '.card', '.dots i', '.tab' to el.
caveats: animated filter: blur() on 760x1000 cards plus backdrop-filter glass and a full-frame blur(60px) wall is slow to render
the wall drift does not yoyo, so the background jumps slightly at the loop point
layout is absolute for a 1080x1920 stage
